summary.scope: All 310 named textbook features and original course entries, including additional whole structures. Twenty vocabulary definitions are separate.
summary.limits: A completed review record is not a claim that every native feature is resolved. Source-only and reference-only records are excluded from scored locating. Offline renders and source checks are distinct from browser layout checks.

items.name: Cervical curvature
items.description: Secondary curve of the neck; develops as the infant holds the head up.
reviewFindings: Guide follows actual C3-C7 anterior vertebral-body positions to show cervical lordotic arrangement.

The region retains all C1-C7 geometry. The guide samples C3-C7 anterior body positions; C1 has no body. The markers lie inside body projection intentionally as alignment references, not surface seams.
items.currentDisposition: Cervical curvature is the shape of a region of the vertebral column. The line is a skeletal alignment guide through representative anterior body positions, not a separate bone or anatomical surface seam. The guide samples C3-C7 while the entire C1-C7 context is retained; C1 has no vertebral body and is not assigned a fictitious body point.
